name: Che dau xanh
summary: Chè đậu xanh is the mung-bean sweet soup the conservation centre names with the other Hoi An chè. The bowl is fragrant with coconut milk. A further recipe was not printed.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article lists it with chè bắp and chè hạt sen.
howToEat: Order a bowl after the meal. The article does not name a topping beyond coconut milk.
where: Hoi An. A stall and the hour are Check on arrival.
